user.title: Sign in to Amazon
user.description: Use the Amazon account your thermostat is linked to in the Alexa app. Your password is only used to sign in and is never stored.

data_description.amazon_domain: The Amazon site you use for Alexa, for example amazon.com or amazon.co.uk.
data_description.otp_secret: Recommended. In Amazon's Two-Step Verification settings add a new authenticator app, choose "Can't scan the barcode?" and paste the long key shown (spaces are fine). Home Assistant will then generate the codes for you. You can also type the current 6-digit code from your authenticator app to use it just for this sign-in.

menu_options.alexa_media: Use my Alexa Media Player sign-in (recommended)
menu_options.credentials: Sign in with email and password

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Amazon ended the session for {email}. Enter your password to sign in again.

security_code.title: Verification code
security_code.description: Amazon sent you a one-time code (authenticator app, SMS or email). Enter it to continue.

captcha.title: Captcha
captcha.description:
Amazon wants to make sure you are not a robot. Type the characters you see.

![captcha]({captcha_url})

credentials.title: Sign in to Amazon
credentials.description: Use the Amazon account your thermostat is linked to in the Alexa app. Your password is only used to sign in and is never stored.

data_description.amazon_domain: The Amazon site you use for Alexa, for example amazon.com or amazon.co.uk.
data_description.otp_secret: Recommended. In Amazon's Two-Step Verification settings add a new authenticator app, choose "Can't scan the barcode?" and paste the long key shown (spaces are fine). Home Assistant will then generate the codes for you. You can also type the current 6-digit code from your authenticator app to use it just for this sign-in.

alexa_media.title: Choose the Amazon account
alexa_media.description: Alexa Media Player is signed in to more than one Amazon account. Pick the one your thermostat is linked to.

menu_options.alexa_media: Use my Alexa Media Player sign-in (recommended)

error.invalid_auth: Amazon rejected the email or password.
error.invalid_domain: Enter an Amazon domain such as amazon.com, amazon.de or amazon.co.uk.
error.invalid_otp_secret: The 2FA app key is not valid. Paste the long key Amazon shows under "Can't scan the barcode?" (about 52 letters and digits 2-7), not an email or SMS code.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Amazon. Check your connection and try again.
error.unsupported_challenge: Amazon asked for a verification step this integration cannot show yet (for example approving the sign-in in the Amazon app). Approve it if asked, or add a 2FA app key, then try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.
error.alexa_media_session_invalid: Alexa Media Player's Amazon session is not valid anymore. Sign in again in Alexa Media Player, then try again. You can also sign in with your password below.
error.alexa_media_cannot_connect: Could not reach Amazon to reuse Alexa Media Player's session. Try again later, or sign in with your password below.

abort.already_configured: This Amazon account is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Signed in, but Amazon did not return your devices. Try again in a few minutes.
abort.no_thermostats: No thermostat was found on this Amazon account. Make sure it shows up in the Alexa app.
abort.alexa_media_not_found: No signed-in Alexa Media Player account was found.
abort.alexa_media_session_invalid: Alexa Media Player's Amazon session is not valid anymore. Sign in again in Alexa Media Player, then try again.
abort.alexa_media_cannot_connect: Could not reach Amazon to reuse Alexa Media Player's session. Try again in a few minutes.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read the thermostat from Alexa, in seconds. Lower values react faster but make more requests to Amazon.

unknown_previous_mode.message: The thermostat is in Eco mode and its previous mode is not known yet. Choose heat, cool or heat/cool instead.

single_setpoint_in_auto.message: The thermostat is in heat/cool mode. Set the low and high temperatures instead of a single target.

auth_failed.message: The Amazon session expired. Sign in again from the integration page.
